Sample type - Peripheral blood in EDTA

Instrument - 3 laser 10 color BD FACS LYRIC

FLOW ID - 2410 FCM0314 PNH012

Panel used - PNH FOR RBCs

 

Diagnosis - NEGATIVE FOR MAJOR PNH CLONE (flow cytometric analysis on RBCs)

Comment - Flow cytometric analysis does not show/ shows the presence of major PNH clone (sensitivity >1%), based upon analysis of GPI linked antibodies on RBCS

Interpretation - Immunophenotypic analysis was done on red blood cells using FSC vs SSC and gating antibodies CD235a. CD59 was used for further analysis. No distinct cell cluster with Type III/ Type II RBCs seen.

 

ADVICE: PNH testing on WBCs is advisable (since RBC testing is not sufficient to rule in/rule out a diagnosis of PNH). RBC analysis is dependent on many variables (blood transfusion, sample storage time and many others).

Please correlate with clinical details (especially transfusion history).

 

This test has been developed and its performance characteristics determined by MODERN Diagnostics

Note - All investigations have their limitations which are imposed by the limits of sensitivity and specificity of individual assay procedures as well as the quality of the specimen received by MODERN. Isolated laboratory investigations never confirm the final diagnosis of the disease. They only help in arriving at a diagnosis in conjunction with clinical presentation and other related investigations.
